purpose: ImageNet-pretrained frozen visual feature baseline for Galar blood-annotation visibility; does not establish pathology detection, lesion sensitivity or clinical utility
experiment_role: historical exploratory development; examination 9 and 10 are previously inspected, not independent tests
training_labels: binary Galar blood annotation only; zero does not imply absence of every pathology
backbone: torchvision mobilenet_v3_small IMAGENET1K_V1; classifier removed; global average pooled final feature tensor, 576 dimensions
preprocessing: torchvision IMAGENET1K_V1 default: RGB, resize shorter side 256 bilinear, center crop 224, ImageNet RGB mean/std
head: binary logistic linear probe; train-feature standardization; train-only inverse-positive frequency BCE; fixed L2=0.01; torch LBFGS max_iter=100, lr=1 with strong-Wolfe search
trainable_layers: linear probe only, full ImageNet backbone frozen
hyperparameter_selection: none; do not use development labels or metrics for fitting/preprocessing or hyperparameter selection
evaluations: ROC-AUC, average precision, per-examination results (null when no positive), and 5/10/25/50/75/100% sampled-frame ranking curves. Compare frozen legacy CNN and fixed redness score on identical images
review_budget_interpretation: fraction of the available sparse sampled images, not full-examination time nor clinical workflow
future_reserve: examinations 11-20 are not yet acquired; source authors' 61-80 holdout remains unopened
repository_policy: aggregate metrics + reproducible code only. Keep ImageNet weights, Galar images/labels, individual scores/manifest and private viewer studies outside Git. No new software licence.
analysis_commitment: report all results, including negative generalization and exam-10-only comparison, without further model search during this run
